basic_details.job_title: CoPA Dy. Chief Engineer Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Cochin Port Authority will fill one post of Dy. Chief Engineer (Civil) by absorption through composite method. The post is open to eligible Superintending Engineer-level officers of the Civil Engineering discipline serving in Major Ports. Applications go through proper channel to the Administrative Office of Cochin Port Authority, Kochi-682009, and must reach on or before 8 January 2027. Pay is in the scale of Rs.80000-220000.

content_sections.heading: About Cochin Port Authority
content_sections.text: Cochin Port Authority is a Major Port Authority with its Administrative Office on Willingdon Island, Kochi, Kerala. The notice is issued by the Secretary of Cochin Port Authority to the Secretaries of all Major Ports, with a copy to the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, Government of India. The Dy. Chief Engineer (Civil) post will fall vacant with effect from 1 March 2027.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed format at Annexure-II and forwarded with prior approval of the Competent Authority, through proper channel, so as to reach the issuing office on or before 8 January 2027. The notice is issued from this office: Administrative Office, Cochin Port Authority, Willingdon Island, Kochi-682009 The steps the notice gives are: Fill in the application form at Annexure-II (Post applied for, name, address, phone, email, date of birth, date of retirement, category SC/ST/OBC/UR, present post and pay scale, date of continuous regular appointment, qualifications, feeder-grade service, employment history, languages known) and affix a passport size photograph. Do not show a pay scale granted as financial upgradation under the Modified Assured Career Progression Scheme (MACPS), as it is not regular service in the grade. Sign the declaration in the form and the Undertaking at Annexure-III. Get the Certificate by Head of Office (Annexure-IV) and the Vigilance/Administrative clearance of the concerned Port (Annexure-V) completed. Attach all documents listed under Enclosures below. Forward the application through proper channel with prior approval of the Competent Authority so that it reaches Kochi by 8 January 2027. The circular and its annexures are also available on the Cochin Port website, www.cochinport.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: One post of Dy. Chief Engineer (Civil) is to be filled in the scale of pay of Rs.80000-220000 (Pre-revised Rs.16000-20800). The Recruitment Rules attached as Annexure-I list the post as Class-I and a Selection post. "Degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognised University/Institution", as prescribed in the Recruitment Rules. Officers holding analogous posts or the post of Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of Civil Engg. Dept. in the scale of pay of Rs. 60000-180000 (pre-revised Rs. 13000-18250) with 3 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port; OR Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of Civil Engg. Deptt. with 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of pay of Rs. 50000-160000 (Pre-revised Rs. 10750-16750) and Rs. 60000-180000 (pre-revised Rs. 13000-18250) in the respective discipline of Civil Engg. Deptt. in a Major Port. The crucial date for determining the qualification and experience is 1 March 2027 . The notice itself prints no age limit. The Recruitment Rules at Annexure-I give an upper age limit of 42 years for direct recruits and mark age as not applicable ("No") in the case of promotion, absorption or deputation. Candidates should check the Recruitment Rules at Annexure-I of the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice: Attested copies of Educational & Professional qualifications. Attested copies of ACRs/APARs of the applicant for the last 5 years. No-Objection Certificate of the respective Ports. Two recent passport size colour photographs in a sealed envelope. An undertaking of the applicant not to withdraw his candidature, if selected (Annexure III). Certificate by Head of Office of the Applicant as per the format (Annexure IV). Vigilance/Administrative clearance of the concerned Port in the proforma attached (Annexure-V). A copy of the order declaring satisfactory completion of probation period in the feeder post prescribed in the RR. Details regarding unauthorised leave/EOL, if any, during the qualifying service period relevant for the post; otherwise, a Nil Certificate. The Head of Office certificate (Annexure-IV) confirms that the particulars are correct, that no disciplinary/vigilance case is pending or contemplated, the officer's integrity, that no major/minor penalties were imposed in the last 10 years, that attested ACRs for the last 5 years are attached, and that the academic certificates were verified. Annexure-V, furnished and signed by the CVO or HOD, covers positions held in the ten preceding years, any CVO charge, suspension, the "Agreed List" or "List of officer of Doubtful Integrity", allegations, punishments, pending proceedings and complaints with a vigilance angle.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection for Dy. Chief Engineer (Civil) is by merit, for which the benchmark in overall grading in the ACRs will not be below "very good". The notice refers to selection by the Services Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Cochin Port Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post of Dy. Chief Engineer (Civil), to be filled by absorption through composite method.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Cochin Port Dy. Chief Engineer (Civil) application?
faq.answer: The application must reach Cochin Port Authority, Kochi, on or before 8 January 2027, through proper channel.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Dy. Chief Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: A Degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognised University/Institution, along with qualifying regular service as Superintending Engineer or equivalent in the Civil Engg. discipline in a Major Port.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for the Cochin Port Dy. Chief Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: Officers of Major Ports holding analogous posts or Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in Civil Engg. with 3 years regular service in the Rs. 60000-180000 grade, or 2 years in that grade with combined regular service of 7 years in the Rs. 50000-160000 and Rs. 60000-180000 scales.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an age limit for this absorption?
faq.answer: The Recruitment Rules at Annexure-I mark age as not applicable for absorption; the upper age limit of 42 years given there is for direct recruits.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale of Dy. Chief Engineer (Civil) in Cochin Port?
faq.answer: The post is in the scale of pay of Rs.80000-220000 (Pre-revised Rs.16000-20800).

faq.question: Q7. How is the Dy. Chief Engineer (Civil) selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by merit, with a benchmark in overall ACR grading not below "very good".

faq.question: Q8. What is the crucial date for eligibility?
faq.answer: Qualification and experience are counted as on 1 March 2027.

faq.question: Q9. What happens if a selected candidate withdraws?
faq.answer: The candidate will be liable for debarment from future selection to Dy. HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years.

faq.question: Q10. Will an advance copy of the application be accepted?
faq.answer: Only if the application through proper channel is received within 15 days of the last date; otherwise the candidature will not be considered.
